description: This file defines an enumeration GatewayAutostartPolicy that contains static functions determining whether certain gateway-related actions should be initiated based on the application's connection mode and pause state.

methods.name: shouldStartGateway
methods.description: Determines whether the gateway should start based on connection mode and paused state.

methods.name: shouldEnsureLaunchAgent
methods.description: Determines whether to ensure the launch agent is active, wrapping shouldStartGateway.
